acceptance.given: A filesystem-capability package declaration and its validator inputs are prepared for inspection.

oracle.expected: The inspected capability artifact separately records explicit read, write, and delete scopes, names the responsible owner, and includes containment/traversal policy metadata; validation diagnostics identify the relevant rule and relative path without exposing forbidden sentinel bytes.
forbidden: Any operation scope is omitted, implicit, or merged without distinction.
No explicit owner is recorded for the operation scopes.
A path-escape or external symlink is accepted after reading forbidden content.
Forbidden sentinel bytes are returned in diagnostics.
oracle.observable: The capability declaration artifact and validator result are inspected after the targeted test execution.

acceptance.then: The artifact contains distinct read, write, and delete scope fields plus an explicit owner, and the validator rejects containment violations before content access while preserving or sanitizing sentinel data.
acceptance.when: Run the A19 validator case against compliant and boundary capability declarations in the disposable fixture root, including an escaping path or external symlink and a forbidden-read sentinel.

failure_intents.selector_intent: scripts/sc/tests/test_skill_quality_capabilities.py::test_a19 must fail with an AssertionError when read, write, delete, owner, or containment metadata is missing or when a boundary violation is accepted.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Add validation and contract coverage requiring distinct filesystem read, write, and delete scopes, an explicit owner, and local containment/traversal policy enforcement with sanitized boundary diagnostics.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Remove the A19 declaration and validator additions while preserving existing package-validation inputs and schema version compatibility.

slice_hint.state_transition: Filesystem capability declarations move from unevaluated or incomplete scope metadata to validated read/write/delete scopes with explicit ownership and enforced local containment.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The A19 pytest selector passes for compliant declarations and rejects missing-scope, missing-owner, escaping-path, and external-symlink cases without exposing forbidden sentinel bytes.
